chunks: Where are those who were given long life and enjoyed it, taught and understood, given respite and were heedless, kept healthy and forgot? They were allowed a long period, granted abundance, warned of painful [punishment], and promised great [reward]. Beware of sins that lead to destruction, and vices that attract wrath.
ai.seo_question: What lesson does Imam Ali draw from the lives of those who have passed away in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) exhorts the believers to reflect on those who have passed away, noting that despite being granted long lives, health, and knowledge, they often fell into heedlessness and forgetfulness. He urges the living to avoid sins that lead to ruin and vices that incur divine displeasure.
